quiz.question: Why does the generator produce a ranked queue instead of a single hypothesis?
options: Because the runner needs depth so it can pop the next hypothesis when the first one fails
Because the mock model only emits lists
Because the embedding requires more than one input
Because the parser cannot read a single block
quiz.explanation: The point of generating a queue is to amortise sampling cost across the loop. When the first hypothesis fails the runner pops the next without a fresh sampling pass.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 排名队列缓存多候选供后续选择，失败原因/重复/预算须明确；并不证明实验已运行或真实成本更低。

quiz.question: What does the temperature ramp accomplish on each pass?
options: It widens the sampling distribution so later drafts can land further from the seed
It increases the embedding dimension
It raises the parser tolerance
It triples the seed value
quiz.explanation: Higher temperature widens the sampling distribution. The ramp encourages each pass to drift further so the novelty filter has something to do.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 对固定logits使用softmax(logits/T)，T>0增大一般降低尖锐度，但不保证下个样本更新颖/正确；mock是桶查表而非概率采样。

quiz.question: When does the novelty filter reject a draft?
options: When its rank score is below the threshold
When its minimum cosine distance to any prior survivor falls below the novelty threshold
When its parser passes but its tag count is wrong
When its draft pass is greater than the queue length
quiz.explanation: Novelty is the minimum distance to prior survivors. If that distance is below the threshold the draft is a near duplicate and is dropped.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 与已接受向量的最小距离小于阈值拒绝；源是<不是<=，等于阈值接受。距离不等学术新颖性，零向量/中文须拒绝或另处理。

quiz.question: Which three components combine in the rank score?
options: Latency, throughput, cost
Novelty, specificity, testability
Temperature, seed, pass index
Variables, metric, baseline length
quiz.explanation: The rank score is a weighted sum of novelty, specificity, and testability. Each sub score lives between zero and one.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 加权novelty/specificity/testability只是启发；variables项数与有baseline字符串不是真实可检验性，需变量定义/协议/预算/可核基线。

quiz.question: Why is the mock language model keyed on a temperature bucket rather than the raw float?
options: Because buckets make the schedule discrete so a small temperature change can pick a different scripted draft
Because the embedding requires it
Because the parser needs an integer
Because floats cannot be hashed
quiz.explanation: Buckets discretise the continuous schedule. Two adjacent temperatures can map to different buckets and pull different drafts from the scripted bank, which is how the mock simulates varied sampling.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 固定阈区间0.35/0.65/0.95是半开分桶，不是原文所谓openinterval，邻近T未跨边界不会换桶；Pythonfloat可hash。

quiz.question: What happens if every draft from the mock model fails the parser?
options: The generator raises a hard error
The queue is empty and each pass logs a parse rejection so the failure mode is auditable
The novelty threshold is lowered automatically
The runner retries with a fresh prompt
quiz.explanation: Parser failures are recorded as logs with a parse reject reason. The queue can come back empty without crashing the loop, and the logs explain why.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 解析失败每轮记原因，可返回空队列；必须区分预算耗尽、解析故障、全重复等原因，真实异常/embedinvalid原source未统一捕获。

quiz.question: Why does the retrieval client run a BM25 pass and a citation graph pass?
options: Because the mock APIs require it
Because the parser fails otherwise
Because BM25 needs the graph to build its index
Because lexical hits miss foundational papers with different vocabulary, and graph hits miss papers that share no citation with the seed
quiz.explanation: Each pass catches what the other misses. Lexical covers shared vocabulary; the graph covers ancestor and descendant papers regardless of vocabulary.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 词汇召回与引文邻居互补，但均依候选和图覆盖；没有anchor时图不会自动找别词基础文献。

quiz.question: Why is the citation graph traversal capped at two hops?
options: Because the Python recursion limit forbids three hops
Because beyond two hops the result set tends to drift off topic and overwhelm downstream ranking
Because BM25 only scores two hops away
Because the corpus only stores two layers of citations
quiz.explanation: Two hops is the practical ceiling. Three hops blows up the result set on a connected graph and rarely returns more on topic papers.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 2hop是本例限制不是普遍研究结论，需节点/边/时间预算和相关性复核；代码把>2静默截2，负值/类型未核。

quiz.question: What does idf evaluate to for a term that appears in every document?
options: Negative infinity
A large positive value
Undefined; the BM25 implementation skips it
A value near zero
quiz.explanation: When df equals N the numerator and denominator inside the log are close, and the +1 keeps the term non negative but small. The contribution of universally common terms is near zero.
quiz.chinese_judgment: df=N时idf=log(1+0.5/(N+0.5))>0，N大趋小；N=1时log(4/3)≈.28768，不能说等于0。

quiz.question: Which keys does the merge step use to dedup hits from the two passes?
options: BM25 score bucket
Stable paper id
Year and first author
Title text
quiz.explanation: Paper id is the stable handle. Title and author are duplicated across versions, year alone is ambiguous.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 同id消重先要真实命名空间与DOI/arXiv版本归一；sourcep001只同一个合成库，跨供应商ID不能自然同值。

quiz.question: What does graph_score return for a paper that is two hops from the seed set?
options: The BM25 score divided by ten
0.3 by default
1.0 by default
Zero
quiz.explanation: The default graph score schedule is 1.0 at zero hops, 0.6 at one hop, 0.3 at two hops, and zero beyond that.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 本例2hop给.3只是rankfeature配置，非相关概率或论文真实性；minshortestpath来自无权BFS。

quiz.question: Why is the corpus loaded once into a RetrievalClient instead of refetched per query?
options: Because the recency score requires it
Because the BM25 index and citation graph are built once at construction time and reused across queries
Because the mock APIs are slow on every call
Because the parser is global
quiz.explanation: Index construction is the expensive step. Reusing the index amortises that cost across every query the client handles.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 同固定语料复用索引/图，需version/invalidation；source其实不调用mockAPIsearch/fetch，不能称外部client合并已接通。

quiz.question: Why does the runner spawn a subprocess instead of importing the experiment script in process?
options: Because subprocess is faster than import
Because a separate process gives the runner a kill handle on timeout or memory limits and isolates crashes from the orchestrator
Because Python disallows nested imports
Because the metrics format requires it
quiz.explanation: A separate process is the simplest isolation the language ships. The parent retains a kill handle and an independent address space, so a crashing experiment cannot take the orchestrator with it.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 子进程隔地址空间/崩溃和提供signal句柄，但保环境/FS/网络/子孙进程权限，不能运行不可信研究代码就宣称sandbox。

quiz.question: Why is the memory cap described as soft?
options: Because it only applies to the heap, not the stack
Because the poller has a non zero interval, so a process can spike above the cap between polls and the runner only acts on the next observation
Because the operating system always overrides it
Because numpy ignores the cap
quiz.explanation: The cap is enforced by polling, not by an in kernel limit. The poller interval is the resolution of the cap, and short spikes can briefly exceed the cap before the next observation.
quiz.chinese_judgment: RSS轮询软上限会错过短峰且只单pid，unsupported需显式policy，限制整个树/输出/CPU/GPU/磁盘另管。

quiz.question: Which terminal label does the runner return when stdout has the metrics but the exit code is non zero?
options: timeout
crash
ok
oom
quiz.explanation: Terminal is ok only when exit code is zero and metrics parsed. A non zero exit code is crash even if some metrics were captured before the failure.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 非零exit即crash即使有partial metrics，本例OOM优先timeout；unknownexit/无合法metrics也不通过。

quiz.question: How does the runner identify the final metrics blob inside stdout?
options: It scans stderr for json
It expects exactly one line of output
It reads the last json line whose keys cover the required metric_keys; earlier covering lines become intermediate metrics
It reads the first json line
quiz.explanation: Final metrics are the last line that parses as json and includes every required key. Earlier covering lines are kept as intermediate metrics for learning curves.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 最后覆盖requiredkeys的JSON仅格式过滤，必须核finite/类型/单位/样本/输入codehash/seed/status；训练日志可伪造，不能当已证实实验。

quiz.question: Why does the ablation helper sweep one knob at a time rather than a full factorial?
options: Because one knob at a time produces a clean axis the evaluator can plot, while full factorial blows up exponentially and confuses interpretation
Because the seed only varies along one knob
Because the runner cannot launch more than one subprocess
Because numpy does not support the cartesian product
quiz.explanation: Single knob sweeps keep the result interpretable. Full factorial costs scale exponentially with the number of knobs and the resulting table is hard to read.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 一次只动一knob便于条件比较但不能识别交互；factorial不是无法解释，应按预算选全/部分因子、随机化和blocking。

quiz.question: What guarantee does forwarding spec.seed into config['__seed'] give the evaluator?
options: Lower memory consumption
Faster wall time
A free significance test
Determinism, so a re run with the same seed produces identical metrics and the evaluator can detect real changes from random noise
quiz.explanation: The seed pins random initialisation in the experiment. Two runs with the same seed produce identical metrics, which is what lets the evaluator distinguish a real regression from a different draw.
quiz.chinese_judgment: seed转交只约定子程序使用它；相同seed不保证walltime/系统/并行结果，更不能用一次seed区分总体随机波动与真改进。

quiz.question: Why does the evaluator use a paired t test instead of comparing two single numbers?
options: Because numpy requires paired arrays
Because the runner cannot emit a single number
Because pairing the same seed across candidate and baseline isolates the configuration change from random initialisation noise
Because t tests are always required by IRB
quiz.explanation: Pairing by seed cancels out random initialisation effects. The remaining difference is attributable to the configuration change, which is what the test measures.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 同seed有助配对随机条件，不保证消除所有噪声/因果归属；d_i为独立配对差，检验差值均值、df=n−1、假设和效应区间要说明。

quiz.question: Why does the evaluator carry a direction field on every metric?
options: Because numpy needs the direction for variance
Because accuracy and loss point in opposite ways; the sign of the improvement depends on which direction is better for the metric being compared
Because the runner requires it
Because the parser expects it
quiz.explanation: Higher is better metrics improve when they go up; lower is better metrics improve when they go down. The direction field tells the improvement function which sign convention to apply.
quiz.chinese_judgment: higher/lower规定好坏符号；baseline=0百分比未定义应选绝对变化，不能用denom1冒称相对率。

quiz.question: What does the verdict path return when |improvement| is below the threshold even if the p value is significant?
options: noise
regressed
failed
improved
quiz.explanation: A statistically significant change that is too small to act on is still noise from the loop's point of view. The threshold gate runs before the significance gate.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 原label noise对应实际效应门槛不足，不等证明没有效应；分practicallysmall/notsignificant/insufficientn更清楚。

quiz.question: Why does the evaluator transform log scaled metrics before computing improvement?
options: Because the p value depends on it
Because numpy logs are faster
Because the runner only emits log scaled metrics
Because perplexity and similar metrics grow exponentially with loss; transforming to log space makes a threshold like two percent meaningful across linear and log metrics
quiz.explanation: Perplexity is exp(loss). A small loss change is a large perplexity change. Taking the log keeps relative improvements comparable to linear metrics under one threshold.
quiz.chinese_judgment: PPL=exp(NLL)，logPPL转NLL有解释，但logmean相对率不等PPL相对率/跨指标统一可比；需明确原单位绝对效应或logratio阈值。

quiz.question: When does the paired t test helper return p_value = None?
options: When the variance is zero
When the means are equal
When the metric scale is log
When fewer than two paired samples are available
quiz.explanation: The t distribution needs at least one degree of freedom. With n less than two there is no variance estimate and the helper returns None so the verdict path can mark the run as noise.
quiz.chinese_judgment: n<2缺方差估计返回None；n>=2零方差也不能把程序约定p0视常规有效t检验/稳健证据。

quiz.question: What happens if even one candidate result has a terminal label other than ok?
options: The evaluator returns a failed verdict and records the bad terminals in the rationale
The evaluator drops that seed and proceeds
The evaluator retries the run
The evaluator falls back to a one sided test
quiz.explanation: A failed run invalidates the candidate set. The evaluator short circuits the verdict path and returns failed with the offending terminals listed, so the orchestrator does not draw a conclusion from a crashed run.
quiz.chinese_judgment: source候选和基线任一terminal非ok都会failed（不止候选）；选择性丢失败seed会改变估计目标，失败率/性能可分别报告。

quiz.question: Why does the writer declare sections, figures, and citations as data before any prose is written?
options: Because BibTeX cannot resolve forward references
Because LaTeX requires a forward declaration
Because the model needs a system prompt
Because the structure is the contract: the harness can validate completeness before prose generation
quiz.explanation: Structure-first lets the harness validate uniqueness, citation coverage, and figure coverage before invoking the prose generator. The skeleton is the contract.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 先定义sections/figures/bib合同便于核结构，但正文论断仍需真实证据/引用支持；source实际先fillprose后validate非严格validate-before-prose。

quiz.question: What does the figure-injection step produce from an experiment manifest?
options: A list of Figure records with stable ids and paths normalised to the paper directory
A bibliography stub
A PDF compiled from artifacts
A model prompt with figure descriptions
quiz.explanation: read_experiment_manifest returns Figure records. Ids are deterministic, paths are normalised, captions come from the manifest.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 产Figure记录不等实际复制/存在/内容与数据一致；relativepath应相对manifest显式basedir再转paperdir，source以进程cwd解释不符。

quiz.question: Which validation failure raises PaperValidationError before any file is written?
options: An abstract longer than 200 words
An odd number of authors
A section that cites a key not declared in the bibliography
A figure path that does not exist on disk
quiz.explanation: Missing bibliography keys, duplicate figure ids, empty title, empty abstract, and unknown figure refs all raise PaperValidationError. Existence on disk is not enforced because the LaTeX compiler enforces it later.
quiz.chinese_judgment: unknowncite和unknownfigref等会拦render；source不查文件存在，body内直接写cite/ref未分析，sectionID重复也未拒。

quiz.question: Why is the prose generator a callable injected into PaperWriter rather than a method on it?
options: Because tests can swap a deterministic MockProseGenerator for a model call without touching the writer
Because LaTeX requires a callback
Because the dataclass cannot hold state
Because Python does not allow methods to take Paper as an argument
quiz.explanation: The writer takes the prose generator as a dependency. The test substitutes MockProseGenerator. Production substitutes a model call. The writer is unchanged.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 依赖注入可独立测试writer和生成器，但generator可能副作用/改paper/maliciousTeX，真实模型替换后仍需重新验数据/证据和权限。

quiz.question: What three files does PaperWriter.write emit on success?
options: paper.tex, references.bib, manifest.json
manifest.json, prose.txt, paper.pdf
paper.tex, paper.pdf, references.bib
outline.json, paper.tex, figures.tar
quiz.explanation: paper.tex is the LaTeX source. references.bib is the bibliography. manifest.json is the structured artifact the critic loop reads next.
quiz.chinese_judgment: 输出tex/bib/manifest，不产生PDF；source三个顺序write没有事务，IO失败可部分覆盖旧版，不是allornothing。

quiz.question: Why is the manifest part of the writer's contract instead of just the LaTeX file?
options: Because downstream tooling (critics, dashboards) reads structured manifests, not LaTeX
Because manifest.json is the only file BibTeX accepts
Because LaTeX is too large to parse
Because LaTeX compilers reject untyped sections
quiz.explanation: The manifest is a stable interface for downstream stages. Critics and dashboards inspect manifest.json. LaTeX is the human-readable artifact, not the machine interface.
quiz.chinese_judgment: manifest利于机器接口，但只有body_chars/keys不含原始正文/证据绑定，不能让critic仅以长度评价论文科学性；需hash/内容/来源及实际编译结果。
